title: Fight Evils with Evals!
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 16:9 editorial hero for the technical essay Fight Evils with Evals. The essay opens 'Every new model arrives wearing a tuxedo of benchmarks' and argues that impressive public scores do not tell you if a model fits your own tasks; tests must come from your particular real failures. Make a sophisticated, slightly wry FASHION EDITORIAL PAPER COLLAGE about a beautifully tailored jacket fitting the wrong silhouette. A large oxblood dinner jacket, cut from deep burgundy handmade paper with elegantly exaggerated asymmetric lapels, is suspended frontally over an irregular blush-pink human-shaped cutout that clearly does not fit its proportions. One narrow pale-yellow paper seam tracing a real torn edge suggests the honest adjustment still needed. The mismatch is visible through the large difference in shoulder shape and one displaced sleeve; do not require small details. A rich powder-pink background fills the whole plate. Graphic front elevation, large cropped shapes, dramatic scale, asymmetric magazine-cover composition, expressive paper fibres and deliberate cut marks. Flattened analogue print/cut-paper language, slight real paper overlap shadows, subtly imperfect ink coverage. An intelligent independent arts journal, visually arresting but elegant, adult and dryly humorous. Keep the jacket and mismatched silhouette as the one central relationship, not a set of explanatory mini objects. Crop-safe dominant silhouette near centre for a future square companion. No text, letters, numbers, words, labels, logos, watermarks, fake measurements, fake charts, plastic 3D, ivory architectural models, blue-and-terracotta palette, trays, slots, gates, keyed apertures, thin crosshatching, tiny decorative symbols or UI. This must look completely different from a beige tabletop paper engineering product photo.
cover_alt: An oversized burgundy paper dinner jacket hangs around an irregular pink silhouette, with a pale torn seam revealing the mismatch.
qualityReview: Fashion editorial metaphor from the article opening. Pink/burgundy frontal oversized composition breaks the first batch's engineering-tabletop formula. Jacket reads at small sizes; fresh square should retain the displaced sleeve and silhouette.
status: Initial candidate; existing finals and frontmatter preserved
